# Archival Dispatch: 24 Master Broadcasts Dated Across GI Jive, Strange Adventure, and AFRS Basic Music Library

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: GI Jive, GI Jill, AFRS, Strange Adventure, Mystery OTR, Basic Music Library, Bing Crosby, Ames Brothers, Spike Jones, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 35 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 35 resolves 24 historical radio master recordings across three Armed Forces and syndicated institutions: 8 Wartime Armed Forces Radio Service broadcasts of ***GI Jive*** hosted by GI Jill (Martha Wilkerson, featuring Benny Goodman, Glenn Miller, and Artie Shaw), 8 global mystery and adventure episodes from ***Strange Adventure*** (1946–1947), and 8 vinyl transcription master discs from the ***AFRS Basic Music Library*** (including Bing Crosby, The Ames Brothers, Spike Jones, Shostakovich, and Beethoven).

---
